name: garden_tree
description: Handcrafted landscape tree (景观树) with 4 species silhouettes x 3 sizes, fully deterministic (same params = same tree). Oak: branched round crown, branches climb as face-connected staircases with tip blobs, large gets 2x2 trunk + buttress roots. Birch: tall slim trunk + elongated canopy + side tufts. Cherry: low fork, two slanted stems, wide flat airy pink canopy. Spruce: conical tapering tiers with cut corners. Canopies are carved ellipsoid blobs — never vanilla solid balls. Upgrade params (defaults = legacy behavior): branching=2/3 forks each branch tip into two child staircases (2-3 levels); taper slims trunk/branch tips log->fence->slab cap; variant=willow drapes leaf strands from the crown rim, variant=buttress_root flares stepped roots around the base. Upgrade-mode trees self-prune any leaf not face-connected to the skeleton.
when_to_use: Park/plaza/garden/avenue trees where the silhouette must be DESIGNED, not random. origin = trunk base cell (min corner of the trunk), y = ground layer the trunk stands on. Use small for courtyards, medium for streets/gardens, large for park landmarks. For an avenue, repeat with the same species+size along a road_segment. branching/taper/variant add close-up craftsmanship for hero trees (入口/地标); plain rows keep the defaults.
use_for: 公园/广场/庭园/行道树;oak=通用庭荫树,birch=纤秀节点树,cherry=春日花树(中式/日式园),spruce=锥形背景树/雪地;branching=3+taper=近景古树,willow=湖畔垂枝,buttress_root=热带板根

origin.notes: 树干基部格(2x2 粗干时为最小角);y = 地面层

species.notes: 橡木圆冠/白桦瘦高/樱花宽冠/云杉锥形

size.notes: 体量;oak large 自动 2x2 干+板根

branching.notes: 分枝级数;0=现有贴面阶梯,2/3=枝端再分叉成 2 条子枝(递归);仅 oak/cherry 有枝可分叉,birch/spruce 无侧枝是物种特征

taper.notes: 锥度收细:干上 1/3 换 fence、细干顶端加 slab 盖;每段枝后半换 fence

variant.notes: willow=冠缘垂下叶绦(spruce 不适用,保持干净锥形);buttress_root=基部四向阶梯板根(内格外翘一格,外格落地)

pitfalls: 树形完全由 origin 哈希定:同一参数同一棵树,想要'另一棵同种树'就挪一格 origin,不要手改输出
枝干是贴面阶梯(横一格竖一格),验收器不会报悬空;别为'顺滑'手删阶梯里的竖格,删了就真悬空
叶团表面有哈希镂空,是手工树的'呼吸感',不是缺块;镂空率按树种调好(cherry 最疏),别补成实心球
birch/spruce 没有侧枝是物种特征,branching 对它们无效;birch 的秀气靠瘦干+侧叶团,别给它加 oak 的分枝逻辑
树冠半径最大 4:要更大的'古木'就种 2-3 棵 large 挨近,别指望单棵树盖 10 格
树干落地那格 y 必须是地表;种在半空或埋干都是 origin 没对地形(先 terraform_pad)
taper 的 fence 段是收细不是镂空,别在 fence 段之间塞回 log;oak large 的 2x2 粗干 taper 只换 fence 不加 slab 盖(粗干没有'尖顶')
example: python patterns/garden_tree.py --params '{"origin":[100,64,100],"species":"cherry","size":"large"}' --out tree.json && python patterns/garden_tree.py --params '{"origin":[120,64,100],"species":"oak","size":"large","branching":3,"taper":true,"variant":"buttress_root"}' --out tree2.json
